responsibility: Is the core machine-description file for the rs6000 backend. It declares register numbers, key UNSPEC and UNSPECV codes, instruction type attributes, generic scalar patterns and expanders, condition and branch forms, atomic and ROP-related RTL, and includes the subordinate md files for synchronization, vector, VSX, AltiVec, MMA, DFP, crypto, HTM, fusion, and PCREL_OPT support, making it the central RTL pattern database for PowerPC instruction selection.
same_name_distinction: Within the core rs6000 group, this is the machine-description file: it defines register numbers, UNSPEC enums, instruction attributes, and core RTL patterns/includes, rather than the C++ backend implementation in rs6000.cc, the macro header in rs6000.h, or the option table in rs6000.opt.
